scope: synthetic finite-precision arithmetic component validation only
preregistration_claim: This is the component contract, not a preregistered LLM experiment or a retrospective claim that unit tests were frozen before development.
weight_contract: nonempty ordered support; unique nonnegative integer symbol IDs; strictly positive integer weights; total <= 2^(state_bits-2)
input_extension: finite supplied bits followed by zeros; extension is not random and is not counted as payload
receiver_output: only resolved E1/E2 bits and resolved pending complements; no final flush
capacity: length of the receiver-recovered source prefix, capped at supplied input length
limit_failure: CapacityLimit before endpoint state or input-read mutation; incomplete frame must be retained as insufficient_capacity
future_model_launch: Requires a separately frozen protocol, message list, public law/codec binding, full-frame criterion, ordinary comparison and receiver-only replay. Not authorized by this component protocol.
